description: Spec 029 ① (Constitution v2.4, Art. V): the fingerprint check leaves out values with a valid Fonto provenance and stays as it was for every other value. Both values of the set are fingerprints of an invented benchmark Aspekto; accent.500 names the Fonto alfa (listed, pinned, with its notice) in deveno.json and passes, accent.600 has no provenance and is reported. deveno.json itself records Fonto values and is not searched.
